meta.name: dev-autopilot
meta.description: Full autonomous execution from idea to working code. Use when user says "autopilot", "autonomous", "build me", "create me", "make me", "full auto" — orchestrates spec → plan → code → QA → validation across the engineering layer agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从想法到代码全自动执行，无需手动干预
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望用一句话让AI自动完成整个开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Execute full development cycle from idea to working code autonomously
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI to autonomously complete the entire development workflow from a single command

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会从你给出的简短想法出发，自动完成需求分析、技术设计、规划、并行编码、测试循环以及多角度验证，最终产出可以运行的工作代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“autopilot”、“build me”等关键词，或者要求全自动构建一个项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个跟踪每日习惯的命令行工具，带连续天数统计。
say.note: Claude 将自动完成从规格到代码的全流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude autonomously takes a brief idea and handles the full lifecycle: requirements analysis, technical design, planning, parallel implementation, QA cycling, and multi-perspective validation, producing working, verified code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "autopilot", "build me", or similar keywords, or when you want end-to-end autonomous execution from idea to working code.

say_en.text: Autopilot a REST API for bookstore inventory with CRUD using TypeScript.
say_en.note: Claude will autonomously expand, plan, code, QA, and validate.

say_en.text: Build me a CLI tool that tracks daily habits with streak counting.
say_en.note: Claude handles the full spec-to-code lifecycle.
